name: Raul Bârsan
intro: I direct, shoot and cut visual stories with rhythm, for brands, events and artists.
about:
Years of working with movement taught me how a body reads on camera: where to put the lens, when to cut, and how to pace a scene so it breathes.

I bring that to every project. I direct talent, move the camera with intention and build edits that feel as good as they look. My background in 2D/3D animation and digital art shapes the rest.
